calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 'return'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(c.net_sales) AS control_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS cc_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.kind='return' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS returns,
       MAX(ctrl.control_net) AS control_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS share
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
JOIN ctrl ON ctrl.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, o.fulfilment_type, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
